cues.en: Hello everybody. We're going to start talking about function calls, which is a very, very important topic regarding dealing with functions that will need to be called and having tools available for an agent,
cues.zh: 大家好，現在開始談函式呼叫，這是非常重要的主題，讓代理程式在需要時能呼叫函式，取得可用的工具，

cues.en: for instance, during execution.
cues.zh: 例如在執行過程中使用。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and get started.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: All right. I went ahead and created the project like usual.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，已經建立好專案，

cues.en: It's called function call demo.
cues.zh: 名稱是 Function Call Demo。

cues.en: And in the project itself, let me bring in all the packages that are needed in here.
cues.zh: 在專案裡加入需要的套件，

cues.en: So I'm going to go right under the property group.
cues.zh: 先到 PropertyGroup 下方，

cues.en: We'll bring in the regular suspects, the 1.1 for the agent framework, the Azure AI OpenAI, the configuration, and the extensions as well,
cues.zh: 加入熟悉的 Agent Framework 1.1、Azure.AI.OpenAI，以及組態和 Extensions 套件，

cues.en: to be able to see it.
cues.zh: 方便使用。

cues.zh: 另外注意 Visual Studio Code 裡的 Copilot，

cues.zh: 問是否要幫忙新增。我當然說謝謝，

cues.zh: 省下一些複製貼上的操作。

cues.zh: 選 Yes，就會加入 UserSecretsId，

cues.en: The same one I've used for the other projects as well so far.
cues.zh: 和目前其他專案共用相同的秘密設定。

cues.en: All right. That is Control-S to save this project.
cues.zh: 按 Ctrl+S 儲存專案，

cues.en: And let's go ahead and start working with the program.cs.
cues.zh: 再開始處理 Program.cs，

cues.en: I'm going to delete everything from here.
cues.zh: 把裡面的內容全部刪除，

cues.en: And let me bring in the code, and I explain exactly how this stuff works.
cues.zh: 貼入程式碼，再詳細說明如何運作。

cues.en: All right. Nothing here is new, folks.
cues.zh: 這裡前面的內容都不陌生，

cues.en: I'm going to get my endpoint and my API key from the Microsoft Foundry, like we did before.
cues.zh: 一樣取得 Microsoft Foundry 的端點與 API 金鑰，

cues.en: I'm going to create the client based on Azure OpenAI client.
cues.zh: 建立 AzureOpenAIClient。

cues.en: Forget a little bit about this weather and my date time.
cues.zh: 先忽略這裡的 Weather 和 MyDateTime，

cues.en: I will explain that in a second.
cues.zh: 馬上會介紹。

cues.en: But for right now, when I create my agent, I'm going to be using GPT-5 mini like we did before.
cues.zh: 目前建立代理程式時，一樣使用 GPT-5 mini，

cues.en: And also as the AI agent, I'm going to create a chat client agent options, give it a name, give it a description, and then my chat option objects in here where I'm going to be sending the instructions.
cues.zh: AsAIAgent 裡建立 ChatClientAgentOptions，設定名稱、描述，再建立 ChatOptions，傳入指示。

cues.en: The instructions will be you're a helpful bot that can call functions to get current weather based on locations.
cues.zh: 指示是：「你是一個樂於助人的機器人，能呼叫函式，依照地點取得目前天氣。」

cues.en: And the way to include function calls actually in the agent framework is inside of the chat options, if you use the tools property in here and you create an array,
cues.zh: 在 Agent Framework 加入函式呼叫的方法，是在 ChatOptions 的 Tools 屬性建立陣列，

cues.en: you can have as many function calls as you need.
cues.zh: 需要多少個函式，就可以加入多少個。

cues.en: You start by saying AI function factory.create and pass the instance of whichever function you've created.
cues.zh: 使用 AIFunctionFactory.Create，傳入你建立的函式實際參照。

cues.en: Notice all the way at the bottom in here I have these functions.
cues.zh: 注意最下方，這裡就是那些函式，

cues.en: I created two classes.
cues.zh: 我建立兩個類別，

cues.en: One is called weather. One is called my date time.
cues.zh: 一個叫 Weather，一個叫 MyDateTime。

cues.en: I give it a description for the function called get current weather.
cues.zh: GetCurrentWeather 函式有 Description，

cues.en: It takes a parameter as a location for as a string.
cues.zh: 接收一個字串型別的 Location 參數。

cues.en: And it will write out a hard-coded in here, but in real life, of course, instead of returning the location saying it's sunny and temperature of 75, this is where you will create an HTTP client, for instance,
cues.zh: 這裡先寫死回傳結果，但實務上當然不會只回傳地點、晴天和 75 度，而是在這裡建立 HttpClient 等物件，

cues.en: and make a call into a weather channel, passing it latitude and longitude or a city like Paris or Orlando, whatever, and then wait for the HTTP response to come back, parse it as JSON.
cues.zh: 呼叫天氣服務，傳入經緯度，或巴黎、奧蘭多等城市，等待 HTTP 回應後，再解析 JSON。

cues.en: So there is some work to be done in here, but that's not our goal inside of this lesson.
cues.zh: 這裡還有一些實作工作，但不是本堂課的重點。

cues.en: This lesson is just to show you that I can call the get current weather or the get current date time as tools to the agent itself, even though I'm hard-coding the values inside of each one of them. Sounds good?
cues.zh: 這堂只是展示，即使函式內的資料先寫死，也能把 GetCurrentWeather 或 GetCurrentDateTime 提供為代理程式工具，明白嗎？

cues.en: So the way to actually do that is to have these tools property and you can add it as an array.
cues.zh: 實際操作，就是在 Tools 屬性放進工具陣列，

cues.en: Even if you have one function call, it still needs to be inside of an array.
cues.zh: 即使只有一個函式呼叫，也要放在陣列中。

cues.en: And the AI function factory create will pass the function based on the instance of the weather that I did here on line 18 and 19.
cues.zh: AIFunctionFactory.Create 會接收函式，這裡來自第 18、19 行建立的 Weather 執行個體，

cues.en: I created an instance of my classes.
cues.zh: 也就是先建立類別的執行個體。

cues.en: And, of course, you don't have to have the class.
cues.zh: 當然，不一定非得有類別，

cues.en: You can just have a static function and you can call it right away from inside of there as well.
cues.zh: 也可以只是靜態函式，直接從這裡引用。

cues.en: And then the second parameter is important.
cues.zh: 第二個參數很重要，

cues.en: Notice it's almost the same like the name of the function, but I actually gave it a name that has an underscore.
cues.zh: 看起來和函式名稱幾乎一樣，但我另外取了帶底線的名稱，

cues.en: This is how LLMs like to have function tools.
cues.zh: 這是 LLM 比較喜歡的工具命名形式，

cues.en: So like a getter with an underscore weather, get underscore current date time, get underscore something.
cues.zh: 例如 get_weather、get_current_datetime，或 get_其他內容，

cues.en: This usually makes it easier as a standard for the LLMs to understand this is a function call and this is what it's supposed to do. All right.
cues.zh: 這類命名通常符合 LLM 常見的慣例，比較容易理解這是函式呼叫，以及它要做什麼。

cues.en: And then the description is extremely important.
cues.zh: 接著，Description 極為重要，

cues.en: Get the current weather for a given location or the date time or get the current date and time as well.
cues.zh: 例如取得指定地點的目前天氣，或取得目前日期時間。

cues.en: What do you think will happen if I take these tools all together and I comment them out? All right.
cues.zh: 如果把這些工具全部註解掉，你覺得會怎樣？

cues.en: Let's comment this out and run this code, for instance, and let's see what it will answer when I say, hey, what is the time right now in Orlando?
cues.zh: 先註解後執行，看看問「現在奧蘭多是幾點？」時會怎麼回答，

cues.en: Or what is the weather in Paris right now?
cues.zh: 或是「現在巴黎天氣如何？」。

cues.en: Trust me, it will not be able to do that, because GPT-5 Mini was actually trained sometime in April of 2024, for instance.
cues.zh: 相信我，它無法正確回答，因為 GPT-5 mini 的訓練資料，例如可能停留在 2024 年 4 月，

cues.en: So if I ask about something going on currently right now in the world, it has no way of knowing.
cues.zh: 所以問目前世界正在發生的事，它沒有方法知道，

cues.en: It stopped training a long time ago. Okay?
cues.zh: 訓練在很久以前就停止了。

cues.en: So having these tools in here, that means that whenever you don't know the question or the answer to the question, and you're asking about the weather, based on the description I see in here in one of those things,
cues.zh: 加入工具後，如果模型不知道答案，而問題是在問天氣，就能依照工具描述，

cues.en: let me highlight this again and bring it back, and you should try it.
cues.zh: 先把這段重新標示、加回來。你也應該自己試試，

cues.en: You should actually comment this code out and ask it questions about right now, about the weather right now in Paris or the time right now in UTC for Orlando or New York or something like that,
cues.zh: 把工具程式碼註解掉，再問現在巴黎的天氣，或奧蘭多、紐約的目前 UTC 時間等，

cues.en: and you'll see it cannot answer that question. Okay?
cues.zh: 就會看到它無法回答。

cues.en: But now when I do this and I ask this question, it will go ahead and receive the list of all the different tools available to it.
cues.zh: 但加入工具後再提問，模型就會收到所有可用工具的清單。

cues.en: And this is something, please allow me like half a minute to explain this, because there is a lot of confusion out there as well.
cues.zh: 這裡請容許我花半分鐘解釋，因為很多人會誤解，

cues.en: The LLM doesn't call this function.
cues.zh: LLM 本身不會呼叫這個函式，

cues.en: The LLM has no way of calling this getWeather or getCurrentDateTime. Okay?
cues.zh: LLM 沒辦法直接執行 GetWeather 或 GetCurrentDateTime，

cues.en: So whenever we start a conversation on an LLM through the agent, even if I say hi, this first hi automatically sends to the LLM a list of all the tools available. Okay?
cues.zh: 每次透過代理程式開始與 LLM 對話，就算只是說 Hi，也會自動把所有可用工具的清單送給它，

cues.en: In the beginning, when the conversation starts, the LLM is very aware of all the tools the agent have available to it.
cues.zh: 所以一開始，LLM 就知道代理程式提供哪些工具。

cues.en: So when you ask a question saying, what is the weather currently in Paris, for instance, what the LLM does is like, okay, let me take a look at the list and the description and find out which one would be
cues.zh: 當你問「現在巴黎天氣如何？」，LLM 會查看清單與描述，判斷哪個，

cues.en: the best function to call, but not by itself.
cues.zh: 函式最適合呼叫，但不是自己執行，

cues.en: It's just going to go back to the agent and say, okay, on your side, on the user side, I see that this tool will be the best one for you to call to get that answers and
cues.zh: 而是回覆代理程式：「在你這邊，也就是使用者端，這個工具最適合用來取得答案，請先呼叫，

cues.en: then send me the answers and I will finish up the job by formatting the answers and give it back to the user.
cues.zh: 再把答案送回來，我會整理答案並回覆使用者。」

cues.en: But just remember that the LLM does not call these functions.
cues.zh: 所以記得，LLM 不會直接執行這些函式，

cues.en: It just gives back to the caller and say, okay, I definitely see that this tool will be the best one to call for what you need.
cues.zh: 只是告訴呼叫端：「我認為這個工具最適合你的需求。」

cues.en: And then you call it and then you send the answers that came back to the LLM to do the final job.
cues.zh: 接著由你這邊呼叫，再把結果送回 LLM，讓它完成最後處理。

cues.en: So the reality, you're doing most of the work on your side.
cues.zh: 實際上，大部分工作發生在你的應用程式這一端，

cues.en: The LLM is doing very, very light lifting at this point.
cues.zh: 此時 LLM 只負責比較輕量的判斷和整理，

cues.en: Does that make sense?
cues.zh: 這樣清楚嗎？

cues.en: So the idea about the LLM calling the function calls, the functions themselves, it's not true.
cues.zh: 因此，說 LLM 自己去呼叫函式，並不完全正確，

cues.en: That's not how the system works. All right.
cues.zh: 系統不是這樣運作的。

cues.en: So you want to give it a shot and see if this will work. All right.
cues.zh: 接著實際試試是否成功，

cues.en: So we'll ask about maybe Orlando or Paris weather.
cues.zh: 例如問奧蘭多或巴黎的天氣，

cues.en: And we'll ask also about the time right now. All right.
cues.zh: 再問目前的時間，

cues.en: Let's go ahead and do a control S on this.
cues.zh: 先按 Ctrl+S，

cues.en: I'm going to go ahead and move into, oh, it's number 13.
cues.zh: 進入對應目錄；喔，這是第 13 個專案，

cues.en: Let me go ahead and get this number 13. There you go.
cues.zh: 找到 13，進到這裡，

cues.en: And we'll say .NET run.
cues.zh: 執行 dotnet run，

cues.en: And what is the question?
cues.zh: 問題是什麼呢？

cues.en: The question, what date is it today? Okay.
cues.zh: 先問：「今天是幾月幾日？」。

cues.en: So we'll see what it does with the what date is it today. All right.
cues.zh: 看看它如何處理今天日期，

cues.en: If I ask that question without using tools, it will tell me April 24th, 2024, because that's the last date it knows when it was trained.
cues.zh: 沒有工具時，可能會回答 2024 年 4 月 24 日，因為那是它訓練時知道的日期，

cues.en: So it would be completely wrong.
cues.zh: 這當然完全錯誤。

cues.en: But notice the tool has been called fetching current date and time. See?
cues.zh: 但注意，工具現在被呼叫了，顯示 Fetching Current Date and Time，

cues.en: Fetching current date and time.
cues.zh: 也就是正在取得目前日期與時間，

cues.en: That means this tool is the one that got called.
cues.zh: 代表呼叫的是這個工具，

cues.en: And now the GPT-5 Mini is going to be responding to that to let us know what the time is here in a second. All right.
cues.zh: 接著 GPT-5 mini 就會依結果回答現在的時間。

cues.en: Again, it took a long time because something's in the setup or something's going on on the Internet regarding the GPT-5 Mini or capacity or something like that.
cues.zh: 這次又花比較久，也許是設定、網路、GPT-5 mini 容量等因素，

cues.en: But it usually doesn't take that long.
cues.zh: 通常不會需要這麼久。

cues.en: Notice here there is a 387 input token.
cues.zh: 注意這裡輸入 Token 是 387，

cues.en: How could it be? All right.
cues.zh: 怎麼會這樣？

cues.en: My question was very small.
cues.zh: 問題明明很短，

cues.en: My question was what date is it today?
cues.zh: 只是「今天是幾月幾日？」，

cues.en: It should be like five or six tokens max, right?
cues.zh: 應該最多五、六個 Token 吧？

cues.en: But 387 because before it actually sent that to the LLM, it went to the tool, and it actually passed a lot of different information to the tool, and the tool responded with all this information, the current weather,
cues.zh: 但現在有 387，因為整個呼叫流程還包含工具定義、傳給工具的資訊，以及工具回傳的目前日期、天氣等資料，

cues.en: blah, blah, blah, blah.
cues.zh: 這些額外內容，

cues.en: And there is a lot of things that went back and forth before it even engaged the LLM.
cues.zh: 在過程中都會來回傳送，再交給 LLM 處理。

cues.en: By the time all the answer came back, it ended up being 387 input tokens, which is cheaper than the output token, which is good.
cues.zh: 最後取得答案時，輸入總共累積 387 個 Token；輸入通常比輸出便宜，這點很好。

cues.en: And then the output token actually included, of course, what I told it to return back, and we're in good shape. Make sense?
cues.zh: 輸出 Token 則包含最終要求回傳的內容，這樣就完成了。明白嗎？

cues.en: So this is how the whole thing works.
cues.zh: 整體就是這樣運作。

cues.en: Let me change something actually in the question as well.
cues.zh: 再修改一下問題，

cues.en: Instead of what date is it today, let's say what is the weather in New York?
cues.zh: 不要問今天日期，改問「紐約的天氣如何？」。

cues.en: No, I don't want to do that.
cues.zh: 這裡不是要這樣改，

cues.en: What is the weather in New York? Let me do this.
cues.zh: 改成「紐約的天氣如何？」，就這樣。

cues.en: Control S, and we'll do another .NET run, and let's see if it will call a different tool for that at this point.
cues.zh: Ctrl+S，再次 dotnet run，看看這次是否會呼叫不同的工具，

cues.en: Let me bring it back up a little bit.
cues.zh: 把畫面往上拉一點，

cues.en: We should see actually the right line fetching weather for New York, okay?
cues.zh: 應該看到輸出 Fetching Weather for New York，

cues.en: And the current weather in New York, because I'm using the argument being passed with as the city, New York is sunny with a temperature of 75, which never happens in New York except a couple of days in the summer.
cues.zh: 也就是紐約的天氣。因為把傳入參數當作城市，這裡顯示紐約晴天、75 度；紐約大概只有夏天幾天才會這樣。

cues.en: All right. Sounds good.
cues.zh: 好，沒有問題。

cues.en: Hopefully that makes sense how to actually create your own functions.
cues.zh: 希望你理解如何建立自己的函式，

cues.en: We're not using anything hosted like Code Interpreter or Web Search or MCPs.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有使用程式碼解譯器、網路搜尋或 MCP 等託管工具，

cues.en: We're going to do all of those.
cues.zh: 後面都會介紹。

cues.en: But this is the simplest way to create your own functions inside of your own classes somewhere maybe, and then pass those as function calls inside of the tools array of the agents,
cues.zh: 這是最簡單的方式：在自己的類別裡寫函式，再把它們放進代理程式的 Tools 陣列，作為函式工具，

cues.en: and then it's the job of the LLM to pick which one should be called by the user at this point to get the answer.
cues.zh: 接著由 LLM 判斷這次應該要求呼叫端執行哪個工具，才能取得答案。

cues.en: All right. Hopefully that was useful, and I'll see you again in the next video.
cues.zh: 希望這對你有幫助，下段影片見。
